description: This file defines a FastAPI-based pass-through proxy for various endpoints, including HTTP and WebSocket passthroughs, for a project involving language model APIs. It handles constructing requests, managing headers, parsing request bodies based on content type, and forwarding messages, with extensive logging, error handling, and support for WebSocket bidirectional streaming, including special handling for certain model setup messages.
